authored_narrative.episode_purpose: A last bridge crossing and a last pass through the boiler room close out the two settings that first tested Gonagi and Dana — not as a farewell tour, but because a Story about crossing thresholds owes its ending to the thresholds themselves.

scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0038.purpose: The bridge that once demanded an irreversible commitment, and was later crossed a second time without ceremony, is crossed a third time here — the anchor's final appearance, now simply part of how they move through the world.
scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0038.stakes: whether a third crossing has anything left to say that the first two did not already establish
scene_spirited_away_bridge_crossing_0038.opposing_force: the risk of repetition for its own sake, answered only by the fact that this crossing genuinely completes something the first two left open

scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0041.purpose: The boiler room, once solitary duty and later shared labor, appears a third time as neither — simply a place they pass through together on the way to somewhere else.
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0041.stakes: whether a setting can stop being meaningful once it stops being difficult
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0041.opposing_force: the room's own unchanged, indifferent scale — it was never going to notice the difference, only they were

shot_spirited_00297.intent: A brief, unlingering pass across the bridge — the first shot in this Story that treats the crossing as simply transit, not a moment to hold on.

shot_spirited_00321.intent: A wide, unhurried walk-through of the boiler room, camera moving with them rather than holding on the room itself — the setting is no longer the subject.
